name: Arudchayan Pirabaharan
headline: Data Science, Research & Senior Data Engineer
summary: Data Science and Research Engineer with senior-level industry experience building reliable analytical data platforms, reproducible pipelines, and automated data-processing workflows. Strong in Python, SQL, PySpark, data cleaning, transformation, validation, and cloud-based analytics, with experience converting complex multi-source data into structured datasets and practical analytical solutions. Retains strong data engineering, DataOps, and platform architecture capabilities while pursuing research-oriented work in empirical analysis and machine-learning-based forecasting. Incoming MSc Data Science student at the University of Basel.

sections.title: Property Data Platform
bullets: Lead and improve data workflows supporting a property-data platform, integrating multi-source property and geospatial data into reliable analytical processes.
Drive data quality, processing-efficiency, and platform-improvement initiatives across Spark-based and cloud-native workflows.
Contribute to architectural decisions and the continued evolution of the platform following its migration from Azure to GCP.

sections.title: Property Data Platform
bullets: Engineered data workflows supporting a property-data platform, integrating information from multiple sources into reliable downstream datasets.
Developed a proof of concept on Microsoft Fabric and evaluated integration with geospatial and analytical tools.
Used Spark-based processing to improve geospatial data quality, processing efficiency, and scalability.
Contributed to platform architecture improvements and supported migration from Azure to GCP while maintaining data continuity and functionality.

sections.title: Research Focus
bullets: Contribute to research-oriented work in data and AI, with an emphasis on applied experimentation, technical investigation, and translating emerging methods into practical use cases.

sections.title: Data Platforms and Applied Analytics
bullets: Designed and implemented ELT workflows for financial, ERP, and operational datasets used in reporting and analysis.
Built PySpark and SQL transformations in Azure Synapse and Databricks to prepare structured analytical datasets and data-lakehouse layers.
Automated data extraction, orchestration, monitoring, and deployment through PowerShell, Azure Functions, Synapse Pipelines, and Azure DevOps CI/CD.
Developed dashboards and reporting datasets in Power BI, with attention to data quality, consistency, and repeatability.
Contributed to a generative-AI data platform for ingesting and analysing structured and unstructured enterprise data, using Azure OpenAI, vector search, APIs, and cloud services.

sections.title: Cloud Data Engineering and Analytics
bullets: Supported enterprise data and AI projects across data ingestion, transformation, cloud analytics, and reporting.
Built practical experience with Python, SQL, Spark, Azure data services, and production-oriented data workflows before progressing into a full-time Data & AI Engineer role.

sections.title: Selected Independent Work
bullets: Delivered independent data and research-engineering support covering data preparation, pipeline development, analytical tooling, and technical problem solving.

projects.title: Real-time Data Pipeline Optimization Tool
projects.description: Built a performance-monitoring tool for Databricks pipelines with automated bottleneck detection and a recommendation component to support more reliable and efficient data processing.
